Name: Ophrah
ModernLocation: Unknown; two towns share the name, one in Benjamin and one in Manasseh
Description: The name belongs to two towns: one in Benjamin's allotment and one in Manasseh, Gideon's hometown, where the angel appeared to him under the oak. The town called Ephraim in John 11 is sometimes identified with Ophrah, but that identification is not certain.
BiblicalSignificance: Ophrah is shared by a Benjamin town and Gideon's hometown in Manasseh.
